contract.purpose: Help a returning person move one dream from passive wanting toward a credible first action without shrinking the larger life around it.
contract.canonicalPurpose: Live helps a person turn passive wanting into a life they can deliberately imagine, plan, and experience.
contract.audience: Returning adults who already have meaningful dreams in Live and need one trustworthy reason to act now.
contract.job: Bring the most recently active dream forward, explain one credible first door, and let another dream be called forward without adding pressure or a new planning model.
contract.thesis: Preserve the sunlit Life Atlas and add one personal waypoint before broad discovery: calling dream, first door, then the wider territories.
contract.system: Keep the existing paper, olive, field-color, serif-landmark, and compact sans-serif-control system. Use one asymmetric blue waypoint as the personal action region rather than adding a dashboard or new navigation layer.
contract.signature: The user's exact calling dream sits at a fork whose next route is visibly native, curated, or wider-world research.
contract.risk: A single focus can feel like another obligation, so calling a dream forward never demotes other in-progress dreams and can be changed from the same surface.

projectCheck.command: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm build

ownerFeedback.note: The owner asked to raise the product to at least 9 without super-drastic changes and delegated the focused coherence pass.
